Description: A campus member can access saved listings with an authenticated profile
Acceptance Criteria: Valid email creates account; invalid input shows error; signed-in member sees profile

Description: Buyers can find active listings using category and keyword
Acceptance Criteria: Search accepts keyword; category filter updates results; empty results show a helpful message

Description: Buyers can inspect the price condition and seller details before contacting
Acceptance Criteria: Detail view shows title price condition seller and image placeholders; closed listing cannot be contacted

Description: Sellers can publish a campus item with required information
Acceptance Criteria: Title price category condition and contact method are required; successful listing appears in search

Description: Members can keep interesting listings in a saved list
Acceptance Criteria: Signed-in member can save and unsave; saved list persists after reload

Description: Interested buyers can ask a seller a question
Acceptance Criteria: Message form validates text; seller receives a message in the prototype inbox

Description: Sellers can close a listing after a sale
Acceptance Criteria: Seller can mark own listing sold; sold listing no longer appears in active search

Description: Members can flag a listing for moderator review
Acceptance Criteria: Reason is required; report is attached to listing; duplicate reports are prevented
